resources.string: Heroes you have not met stay hidden behind a question mark. Tap a hero to level up, add stars and learn skills. A golden card means a legend is stirring: follow it in the journal.
Stars are limited by your Hall. Raise the Hall in the village to take your heroes further. A star also raises the highest level a hero can reach.

Legendary heroes never answer a call. A rumor announces each one a chapter ahead. Then build the Stone Circle in the village and keep three vigils: each night asks for coins, crystals and late crops from your barn, then a real wait that nothing can shorten. You can prepare everything in advance. The last legend only comes once the other three stand with you.
The way is not open yet.
Only when the other three stand together.
Travellers speak of a woman who walks in sunlight at dusk. Wounds close where she passes.
No arrow is ever found where a stranger vanished on the old path. Someone still keeps watch.
At every new moon a hammer rings from a forge nobody has ever seen. The blade it makes never rusts.
Frost writes names on the windows at midsummer. It waits for three others to stand together.
Every harvest puts crops in the barn, up to %1$d of each. Buildings use them to reach their next tier, the quests ask for them and so do the legends. A bigger Hall makes the barn bigger.
Erase this world and begin again from the first day? Buildings, heroes and progress of this world are lost.
